Theme

Latin word

conjūnctiō

conjūnctiō, conjūnctiōnis f.

noun, third declension

a joining together, union, combination; a conjunction; connection; a connection, a joining; joining or union; a connection, a relationship (of kinship or friendship)

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fin. 5.67: conjūnctiō virtūtum (Lewis & Short)
